zh-CN.title: TikTok 带货图文生成 by 灵途 AI
zh-CN.description: 从商品资料策划 TikTok 带货图文，确认后生成成套图片与发布文案。
zh-CN.prompt: 为这款商品策划 5 张面向美国市场的 TikTok 带货图文，先给我逐页方案。
zh-CN.input: 商品图片、真实卖点、目标市场与语言。
zh-CN.output: 逐页方案、图片提示词、发布文案及确认后生成的图片。
zh-CN.requirement: 策划无需 API Key；生成图片时需要配置 LINGTU_API_KEY，不自动发布。
highlights: 先策划逐页内容与视觉风格
确认后逐页生成商品图片
提供目标语言的标题、正文和标签

en-US.title: TikTok Product Carousels by LINGTU AI
en-US.description: Plan shoppable TikTok carousels, then generate images and captions after approval.
en-US.prompt: Plan a five-image TikTok product carousel for the US market; show the page-by-page plan first.
en-US.input: Product images, supported selling points, target market, and language.
en-US.output: Page plans, image prompts, captions, and images generated after approval.
en-US.requirement: Planning needs no API key. Image generation requires LINGTU_API_KEY. Publishing is not automatic.
highlights: Plan each page and a consistent visual style
Provide localized titles, captions, and hashtags
